mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order ( user_id, order_date, ship_address1, ship_address2, ship_city, ship_state, ship_postal_code, ship_country, bill_address1, bill_address2, bill_city, bill_state, bill_postal_code, bill_country, total_price, bill_to_first_name, bill_to_last_name, ship_to_first_name, ship_to_last_name, status_code, create_user_id, create_program, update_user_id, update_program ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{orderDate}, #{shipAddress1}, #{shipAddress2}, #{shipCity}, #{shipState}, #{shipPostalCode}, #{shipCountry}, #{billAddress1}, #{billAddress2}, #{billCity}, #{billState}, #{billPostalCode}, #{billCountry}, #{totalPrice}, #{billToFirstName}, #{billToLastName}, #{shipToFirstName}, #{shipToLastName}, #{statusCode}, #{createUserId}, #{createProgram}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateProgram} )
mapper.select: SELECT ol.item_id AS item_id, p.name AS product_name, ol.quantity AS quantity, ol.unit_price AS unit_price FROM t_order_line ol JOIN m_item i ON i.item_id = ol.item_id JOIN m_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE ol.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY ol.line_num
